_readme: Reference LASSCF energies produced by running mrh (GPL) LOCALLY. mrh is
never imported by, vendored into or shipped with this repository; only
the resulting numbers live here, which is data, not code.
Fill e_lasscf with mrh's lasscf_o0.LASSCF energy for the stated system,
and record the mrh commit and PySCF version you used. Entries left null

H4_sto3g.active_orbitals: all 4 RHF MOs, localised onto H0-H1 and H2-H3

H8_sto3g.active_orbitals: all 8 RHF MOs, localised onto consecutive H2 units
